brief: A portable electronics organizer: a base with removable bins for small parts, at least one drawer, and a carry handle.

requirements.evidence: Assembly of 7 bases: 3 full bases at level 0 (0,0,0; 1,-1,0; 1,0,0) plus half-s at 0,1,0, with 3 bases at level 1 forming upper deck. Provides stable organizer body.
bin:0,0,1~hex-bin-full-div2 (2 compartments) and bin:1,-1,1~hex-bin-full-div3 (3 compartments) — both lift-out hex bins, dressed with screws/nuts/standoffs to show small-parts use
drawer:0#0,1#cut on cut face of piece:0,1,0;half-s with cover above; contains tweezers prop
handle:1,0,1;top mounted on cover:1,0,1;full;top via inserts, centered on top deck for portability

finish.summary: Two-storey hexagonal organizer: lower level provides drawer front, upper level provides two compartmented removable bins and a top cover with carry handle. Electronics small-parts staged inside bins/drawer; meshClash clear, joints locked.

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
